headline: On November 2, 2022: Ethiopia and TPLF sign peace agreement
captionCards: The agreement marked the second anniversary of the war
instagramCaption:
Ethiopia and the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) make peace. \\[The Ethiopia–Tigray peace agreement, also known as the Pretoria Agreement or CoHA, was signed on November 2, 2022, ending the Tigray War. Both parties agreed to a 'permanent cessation of hostilities.' The agreement took effect the next day, marking the second anniversary of the war. This historic accord brought an end to a conflict that had caused immense suffering. \\Why is this still important today?
